question: Which products were below their reorder point on October 3, 2026?
How much stock of Trail Runner was on hand across warehouses on October 3, 2026?
List inventory in Reno on October 3, 2026.

description: Physical stock for one product at one warehouse on one snapshot date. Additive across warehouses on the same date.
SKU identifier matching the sales domain.
Warehouse-specific reorder threshold. Low stock means on_hand_units < reorder_point_units; equal is not below threshold.
Daily snapshot date. Never add stock across snapshot dates. Fixture date is 2026-10-03.

question: Which products were below their reorder point on October 3, 2026?
sql: SELECT i.product_id, i.product_name, i.warehouse, i.on_hand_units, i.reorder_point_units FROM northstar_demo.retail.inventory AS i WHERE i.snapshot_date = DATE'2026-10-03' AND i.on_hand_units < i.reorder_point_units ORDER BY i.product_id, i.warehouse LIMIT 20

question: How much stock of Trail Runner was on hand across warehouses on October 3, 2026?
sql: SELECT i.product_id, SUM(i.on_hand_units) AS on_hand_units FROM northstar_demo.retail.inventory AS i WHERE i.snapshot_date = DATE'2026-10-03' AND i.product_name = 'Trail Runner' GROUP BY i.product_id ORDER BY i.product_id LIMIT 20

question: List inventory in Reno on October 3, 2026.
sql: SELECT i.product_id, i.product_name, i.on_hand_units, i.reorder_point_units FROM northstar_demo.retail.inventory AS i WHERE i.snapshot_date = DATE'2026-10-03' AND i.warehouse = 'Reno' ORDER BY i.product_id LIMIT 20
